title: Bessie Head's birth chart
metaDescription: Bessie Head's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 13.9° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.6° separates Venus and Pluto from an exact sextile; at that range taste and depth read as one mechanism. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 13.9° Cancer, inside the second decan (10°–20°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 11.4° Cancer, Venus was at 28.5° Taurus, Mars was at 20.1° Scorpio. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Pluto — a sextile holding at 0.6°. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, the Sun sextile Uranus at 1.0°, and Mercury sextile Uranus at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. Venus in Taurus at 28.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Scorpio at 20.1° is in domicile; Jupiter in Capricorn at 23.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Aries at 5.0° is in fall. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in water, 4 in earth, 1 in air, 1 in fire by element, 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Jupiter was retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Gemini for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.8° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 19.6°.
